Name: Green Grove Furniture
Author: skellady
Description:
[center][img]https://imgur.com/EDtmMA2.png[/img]﻿[/center]
[size=3]This mod adds 100+ furniture pieces through Content Patcher. You can find the furniture in the Green Grove catalogue,
which can be bought from Robin's store for [b][color=#e69138]30,000 gold[/color][/b] (configurable). You can also search for [b][color=#e69138]"skellady"[/color][/b] in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url] to find the furniture if you don't want to buy the catalogue. The new wallpapers and floorings are added to the vanilla walls/floors catalogue.

[size=3]
[size=3]This set contains couches, armchairs, tables, desks, small decorations, rugs, and more![/size][/size]

[/size][color=#6aa84f][size=4][b]CONFIG OPTIONS: [/b][/size][/color][size=3]
[b]Catalogue Price:[/b] Set the value here to whatever you prefer. 30000 by default.
[b]ColorScheme:[/b] Original or Saturated. Original by default. See mod screenshots for both options.
[b]AddWallsAndFloors:[/b] true or false. true by default.
[size=3]

Mods used in the screenshots:
[color=#6aa84f][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30038]Kisaa's Cozy Rustic Farmhouse[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16717]HxW Greenhouse Furniture[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27047]PC's Rattan Furniture[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27174]HxW Decorative Plants Furniture Set[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16874]HxW Fairy Garden Furniture[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18814]HxW Farmers Market Furniture[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27124]HxW Plant Lovers Furniture[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20011]Cozy Chocolate Furniture[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20012]Cozy Chocolate Kitchen[/url][/color]

[center]
[img]https://imgur.com/megF8wO.png[/img]﻿[/center]

[size=3]1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20628]Calcifer[/url].
2. Install this mod.
3. Extract all and drop them into your Mods folder.[/size]

[img]https://imgur.com/pzXJlvT.png[/img]﻿[/center]
